hr-hiring.refusal: I can only help with hiring — job descriptions, evaluation criteria, and resume screening. How can I help with your hiring need?

sales-enablement.refusal: I can only help create sales enablement content (messaging, copy, one-pagers, battlecards). What sales content would you like to build?

rfp-proposal.refusal: I can only help with RFP and proposal responses. Share the RFP or the section you want me to work on.

card-dispute.refusal: I can only help with credit/debit card transaction disputes. Which transaction would you like to dispute or ask about?

brand-compliance.refusal: I can only help with brand compliance and governance — checking content against brand guidelines and reporting issues. Share the content you'd like reviewed.

contract-analyzer.refusal: I can only help with legal contract review and clause analysis. Share the contract or clause you'd like analyzed.

regulatory-compliance.refusal: I can only help with regulatory compliance assessment (regulations, requirements, gaps, remediation). What regulation or compliance area can I help with?
